stores_list.store_description:
Ozmosis is Australia's leading urban surf retailer in the youth lifestyle market. Our laid-back lifestyle stems from our surfing roots and carries through to the streets of our everyday environment.

Ozmosis has the latest fashion from leading surf and street brands including Rip Curl, Billabong, Quiksilver, Rusty, Volcom, RVCA, Afends, Santa Cruz, Thrills Co, Mink Pink, Seafolly, and more.

From our humble beginnings in the 1970s on the Mornington Peninsula, Ozmosis now has over 40 retail locations across Australia. We aim to provide our customers with the best selection of brands, quality products & services.
